::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 7th [1865]  
**From:** Ottery  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/Cobweb-7[^1]
:::

My dear [Cobweb](people/person_675.qmd),
I am staying here with the [Secretary](people/person_351.qmd) and we both give our parting greetings to one of our oldest original [members](organizations/other_104.qmd). I wonder if you will ever have time to continue the Composer series in the [Barnacle](organizations/other_89.qmd)- I remember when [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd) told me how many lives you proposed, I was rather alarmed for the chance of the Barnacle living long enough to contain them all. 

If you wish still to see the said Barnacle, please let Christabel know- though what is become of the present one is more than I can say

your affectionate
Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Tiny blue envelope 54mm x 94mm postmarked Ottery and Exeter 7 September 1865 and London S. W. 8 September 1865.
